comment: Forms of government (GDD 7.2; stage 4f, ADR 0023). title: the civilization's title, {people} is the people's name. fromEra: the first era (key from eras.json) in which a civilization may take it. enactYears: years before a state decision (a new government, a declared war: its armies wait) takes effect; very fast 0, fast 1, medium 2, slow 4. reviewPercent: the strategist and the diplomat review this many percent of their usual interval (lower = a faster state). cautionShift: added to the civilization's caution (per mille) when the AI decides whether to take its best option outright; negative = more impulsive. goalPercent: percent applied to the strategist's goal weights (expansion, security, prosperity, science, influence, conquest); missing goals stay 100. leaning: how much each trait draws a new people to this government at the start; the government with the highest sum of trait x leaning wins (ties: the first). Despotism and the city republic come with the bronze age (stage 6).
